page.overview:
What is Wattrel?

Wattrel is a nest-building species; it makes its nest on top of cliffsides in coastal areas. Oddly enough, the nest that Wattrel builds is a sought-after delicacy as its crackling texture gives off a savory taste.

Wattrel absorbs electricity from the wind that it catches via its wings. It uses this ability to electrocute underwater prey.

Wattrel evolves into Kilowattrel starting at level 27.

Wattrel's name may be based off of tne word "Watt", an electrical term, and possibly the bird species "".
